title: Reduced-motion title sequence
description: The reduced-motion version of a title sequence (design/opening-titles.md, the tenth round): a shorter cut list over the same song, built at render time from the full timeline named by `base` (tools/title-sequence/titleseq/reduced.py). Every segment plays the middle of one of the full opening's shots at `motion` of its pace or slower, cuts dissolve, flashing layers are dropped. Never synced to the Foundry server.

motion.description: The share of each shot's own pace its segment plays at, at most: 0.5 is half the movement at half the speed.

dissolve.description: Frames of cross-dissolve at every cut.

shots.description: A run of shots taken as one: [first, last].

until.description: The reduced video's track time (seconds) this segment runs to.

layer_overrides.description: Clip id -> layer parameters held at these values.

text.description: Settings forced on every text layer (no flicker, no weave).

finish.description: Overrides to the full timeline's finish (`vhs`: no dropouts, less jitter).
